meta.dataset: World Bank World Development Indicators (literacy series, data from UIS)
meta.retrieval_method: World Bank API v2; most recent non-empty value per country (mrnev=1), plus Jamaica youth-literacy history.
meta.caveat: Raw API responses preserved in data/raw/worldbank/2026-11-27/.
meta.is_estimate: The API records retrieved do not state whether a value is a UIS estimate. Marked null (unknown) until checked against UIS metadata.
